note: Only EmuTOS is listed here, because it is the only ROM this project may redistribute. A ROM identity is keyed by the exact SHA-256 of the image, so an entry for an Atari TOS release is only meaningful once someone has hashed a ROM they actually hold. Add your own through Tools > ROM Workbench > Identity; those records are stored per owner and are never published from here.
